note: Original student recipe templates. Nutrients are computed from sourced ingredient records. Costs use separate explicit demo package estimates; not live retailer quotes. Grain quantities marked cup use cooked measures.

recipes.name: Strawberry chia overnight oats
steps: Stir oats, soy milk, chia and syrup in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight; top with sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Raspberry ricotta breakfast toast
steps: Toast bread.
Spread ricotta; add raspberries and honey.

recipes.name: Mango soy protein smoothie
steps: Blend soy milk, protein powder, mango, oats and flaxseed until smooth.

recipes.name: Blackberry flax yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in oats and flaxseed; top with blackberries and honey.

recipes.name: Pear walnut porridge
steps: Simmer oats in milk until soft.
Slice pear; serve over oats with walnuts and syrup.

recipes.name: Pistachio kiwi yogurt bowl
steps: Peel and slice kiwi.
Layer yogurt, kiwi, pistachios and granola.

recipes.name: Quinoa berry breakfast bowl
steps: Simmer quinoa following its package directions; measure the listed amount after cooking.
Warm with soy milk; add blueberries, seeds and syrup.

recipes.name: Millet mango breakfast porridge
steps: Simmer millet following its package directions; measure after cooking.
Stir in soy milk, then top with mango, chia and syrup.

recipes.name: Kale mushroom egg toast
steps: Saute mushrooms and kale in oil.
Add eggs and scramble until set.
Toast bread and serve with the scramble.

recipes.name: Goat cheese and tomato egg plate
steps: Saute chopped tomato in oil; add eggs and cook until set.
Toast bread; serve with eggs and crumbled goat cheese.

recipes.name: Pineapple coconut chia oats
steps: Combine oats, soy milk, coconut milk and chia.
Refrigerate overnight; top with pineapple.

recipes.name: Orange cottage cheese breakfast bowl
steps: Peel and segment orange.
Serve with cottage cheese, oats and walnuts.

recipes.name: Cashew raspberry breakfast oats
steps: Simmer oats in soy milk until soft.
Add cashews, raspberries and syrup.

recipes.name: Edamame egg breakfast rice
steps: Prepare rice according to package directions; measure after cooking.
Simmer edamame according to package instructions.
Scramble eggs in oil, then add rice and edamame; finish with sesame.

recipes.name: White bean avocado breakfast toast
steps: Toast bread.
Mash cooked white beans with avocado and lemon; spread on toast.
Top with sliced radishes.

recipes.name: Brown rice banana breakfast bowl
steps: Warm cooked brown rice with soy milk in a pan.
Add banana, pumpkin seeds and syrup.

recipes.name: Lemon quinoa edamame bowl
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Prepare edamame following package instructions.
Chop vegetables and toss with quinoa, edamame, lemon and oil.

recipes.name: Bulgur white bean vegetable bowl
steps: Simmer bulgur; measure after cooking.
Saute zucchini and tomato in oil; stir in cooked beans.
Serve over bulgur with lemon.

recipes.name: Brown rice chicken broccoli plate
steps: Simmer brown rice; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear sliced chicken until a thermometer reads 165F.
Steam broccoli; serve with rice, chicken, oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Couscous roasted vegetables and feta
steps: Roast diced vegetables with oil at 425F until tender.
Boil water and prepare couscous according to package directions; measure after cooking.
Combine with vegetables, feta and lemon.

recipes.name: Wild rice turkey grape bowl
steps: Simmer wild rice according to package directions; measure after cooking.
Combine rice with sliced ready-to-eat turkey, grapes, arugula, walnuts and oil.

recipes.name: Roasted beet goat cheese quinoa bowl
steps: Roast diced beets with oil at 425F until tender.
Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Top quinoa and arugula with beets, goat cheese and seeds.

recipes.name: Mushroom barley lentil pilaf
steps: Simmer barley and lentils separately according to package directions.
Measure barley after cooking; lentil quantity is measured dry.
Saute onion and mushrooms in oil; fold into grains.

recipes.name: Chickpea cucumber feta quinoa
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Drain chickpeas and slice cucumber.
Combine with quinoa, feta, lemon and oil.

recipes.name: Tahini cauliflower chicken bowl
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Saute cauliflower and sliced chicken in oil until chicken reaches 165F.
Whisk tahini with lemon and a splash of water; drizzle over the bowl.

recipes.name: Red cabbage tofu sesame rice bowl
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Pan-fry tofu in oil; add shredded cabbage and carrots until tender.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Mango lentil quinoa bowl
steps: Simmer lentils and quinoa separately; lentils are measured dry and quinoa cooked.
Combine with mango, spinach, lemon and oil.

recipes.name: Pear arugula white bean bowl
steps: Toss cooked beans, sliced pear, arugula, walnuts and oil.
Toast bread and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Sockeye salmon quinoa lunch bowl
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear salmon in oil to 145F at the centre.
Serve with quinoa, cucumber, kale and lemon.

recipes.name: Edamame tahini millet bowl
steps: Simmer millet and prepare edamame according to package directions; measure cooked portions.
Chop vegetables and toss with grains and edamame.
Thin tahini with lemon and water for dressing.

recipes.name: Ricotta spinach tomato toast
steps: Saute spinach and tomato in oil.
Toast bread; spread with ricotta and top with vegetables.

recipes.name: Warm chicken orange couscous
steps: Boil water and prepare couscous; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear sliced chicken with oil until it reaches 165F.
Combine with orange segments and spinach.

recipes.name: Wild rice cashew chickpea bowl
steps: Simmer wild rice; measure after cooking.
Saute pepper in oil and add drained chickpeas.
Combine with rice and cashews.

recipes.name: Lentil kale roasted squash bowl
steps: Roast diced squash with oil at 425F until tender.
Simmer lentils and quinoa separately; measure lentils dry and quinoa cooked.
Wilt kale in the hot lentils and assemble.

recipes.name: Sockeye salmon asparagus quinoa
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Roast salmon and asparagus with oil at 400F; cook salmon to 145F.
Serve with quinoa and lemon.

recipes.name: Mackerel brown rice and greens
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear mackerel in oil to 145F at the centre.
Saute kale; serve with rice and lemon.

recipes.name: Lemon cod white bean skillet
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Saute tomato and kale in oil; add cooked white beans.
Nestle cod into the pan, cover and cook until the centre reaches 145F.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin barley and brussels sprouts
steps: Simmer barley; measure after cooking.
Roast sprouts with oil at 425F until tender.
Sear pork medallions to 145F; rest at least 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken mushroom wild rice plate
steps: Simmer wild rice; measure after cooking.
Saute onion and mushrooms in oil.
Pan-sear sliced chicken until its centre reaches 165F; serve with rice and vegetables.

recipes.name: Chicken butternut brown rice plate
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Roast squash and chicken with oil at 425F.
Use a thermometer to confirm chicken reaches 165F.

recipes.name: Roasted cauliflower chickpea tahini plate
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Roast cauliflower and drained chickpeas in oil at 425F until golden.
Drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon and water.

recipes.name: Bulgur eggplant white bean skillet
steps: Simmer bulgur; measure after cooking.
Saute eggplant and tomato in oil until tender.
Add cooked white beans and serve over bulgur.

recipes.name: Ricotta spinach zucchini bake
steps: Boil pasta until just tender.
Combine with zucchini, spinach, ricotta, sauce and oil.
Bake at 400F until vegetables are tender and filling is hot.

recipes.name: Tomato feta quinoa white bean bake
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Combine quinoa, cooked beans, tomatoes, feta and oil in a baking dish.
Bake at 400F until tomatoes soften and filling is hot.

recipes.name: Cashew edamame millet stir-fry
steps: Simmer millet and prepare edamame according to package directions.
Saute pepper in oil; add cooked millet, edamame and cashews.

recipes.name: Walnut lentil mushroom rice bowl
steps: Simmer lentils and rice separately; measure lentils dry and rice cooked.
Saute mushrooms in oil; stir in lentils and walnuts.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Pork red cabbage potato plate
steps: Roast diced potatoes with oil at 425F until tender.
Saute cabbage with orange juice.
Pan-sear pork medallions to 145F; rest at least 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Pistachio salmon wild rice plate
steps: Simmer wild rice; measure after cooking.
Top salmon with crushed pistachios and roast with asparagus and oil at 400F.
Cook salmon until a thermometer reads 145F.

recipes.name: Shrimp asparagus wild rice skillet
steps: Simmer wild rice; measure after cooking.
Saute asparagus and garlic in oil.
Add shrimp and cook until pearly and opaque; fold in rice.

recipes.name: Coconut mango tofu brown rice
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Simmer tofu with coconut milk and curry powder until hot.
Add mango and spinach; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken pear spinach quinoa plate
steps: Simmer quinoa; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear sliced chicken in oil to 165F.
Add sliced pear and spinach until just warmed; serve over quinoa.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken millet and greens
steps: Simmer millet; measure after cooking.
Pan-sear chicken with oil until its centre reaches 165F.
Steam broccoli and serve with millet, arugula and lemon.

recipes.name: White bean vegetable quinoa chili
steps: Saute pepper with oil and chili powder.
Add tomatoes and cooked beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with quinoa prepared according to package directions and measured cooked.

recipes.name: Roasted brussels tempeh brown rice
steps: Simmer rice; measure after cooking.
Roast cubed tempeh and sprouts with oil at 425F until tender.
Finish with tahini and lemon.

recipes.name: Cod zucchini couscous plate
steps: Boil water and prepare couscous; measure after cooking.
Saute zucchini and tomato in oil.
Pan-sear cod to 145F at the centre and serve.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable millet and goat cheese
steps: Roast diced squash and beets with oil at 425F until tender.
Simmer millet; measure after cooking.
Serve topped with goat cheese and pumpkin seeds.
